summary: MDA Space filed a Form 6-K announcing TSX acceptance of its notice of intention for a normal course issuer bid, the Canadian equivalent of a US issuer repurchase program. The company may buy back up to 8,106,539 common shares, about 5% of the 162,130,797 outstanding as of September 11, 2026, over a 12-month period from September 23, 2026 to September 22, 2027. Daily purchases are capped at 313,258 shares, subject to the TSX block purchase exception, at market prices for cancellation. An automatic share purchase plan with its broker permits repurchases during blackout periods. Watch actual execution pace and any leverage or capital-allocation signals.
